description:
Use this when you need a New Zealand national statutory public-holiday result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a regional anniversary, school, bank, exchange or employer calendar.
What it computes: Checks a New Zealand date against the Saturday-Sunday baseline and exact 2026-2027 national public holidays, including observed dates.
Example user requests: Is 2027-02-08 a New Zealand working day?
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-02-08"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, holiday_names, calendar_scope, regional_anniversary_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = Monday-Friday and no exact national public holiday or observed date
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/new-zealand-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/new-zealand-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in New Zealand national 2026-2027 coverage.

name: check_new_zealand_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

holiday_names.description: National holidays applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no national statutory holiday.

regional_anniversary_day_policy.description: Regional anniversary days are not inferred.

sources.description: Official New Zealand Government and Employment New Zealand sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: New Zealand Working Day
